description: This file contains unit tests for the BearerTokenValidator class in the OAuth Server module of the OrangeHRM project. It tests various scenarios related to OAuth2 token validation, including missing headers, invalid tokens, revoked tokens, expired tokens, and valid token processing. The class extends a kernel test case framework and uses mock services to simulate different conditions.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidatorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the behavior of the BearerTokenValidator in various OAuth2 token validation scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads test fixtures, and sets up necessary objects such as the AccessTokenRepository and encryption key.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithoutAuthorizeHeader
methods.description: Tests the validation method when the Authorization header is missing, expecting an OAuthServerException indicating a missing header.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Tests behavior when the Authorization header has an invalid value, expecting a LogicException due to invalid hex encoding.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidToken
methods.description: Tests behavior with an invalid token string, expecting a LogicException for invalid hex encoding.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidEncryptionKey
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the decryption key used does not match the encrypted token, expecting an integrity check failure exception.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithRevokedToken
methods.description: Tests the scenario where the token has been revoked, expecting an OAuthServerException indicating revoked status.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithNonExistingToken
methods.description: Tests validation when the decrypted token ID does not exist in the database, expecting an OAuthServerException for unverified token.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredToken
methods.description: Tests behavior with an expired token, expecting an OAuthServerException indicating expiration.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredTokenAfterOneYear
methods.description: Tests token expiration after a year, expecting an expiration exception.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredAndCurrentTimeSame
methods.description: Checks token validity when the current time equals the expiry time, expecting successful validation and correct token attributes.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorization
methods.description: Validates a correct token, asserting that the access token object returned has the expected attributes.
